County approves bridge repair

Published 5:00 pm Tuesday, September 15, 2026 By Jordan Reyes

The county approved a bridge repair project on Old Mill Road during Monday's commission meeting, ending months of detours for residents on the east side.

Construction begins next month and is expected to last about eleven weeks. Commissioners said the state transportation grant covers most of the $1.2 million cost, with the remainder drawn from the county's road maintenance fund.

Email newsletter signup

The public works director told commissioners that school buses will use the Pine Street route while crews replace the deck and guardrails. A temporary traffic signal will be installed at the Pine Street intersection before work starts.

Residents with questions about the detour can call the county public works office during business hours.
